# Chatrove – AI Chat Folders & Handoff

## Overview

Hit your AI limit? Continue any chat in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini in one click. Plus folders, saved prompts and // shortcuts.

Hit your AI limit in the middle of something important? Chatrove moves the whole conversation to another AI in one click, so you can keep going without copy-pasting or explaining everything again. Chatrove adds a small panel to ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and your library is the same on all three. CONTINUE IN ANOTHER AI • Out of messages in Claude, or ChatGPT is busy? Tap "Continue in" and pick ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. • Chatrove copies the conversation, opens the other AI and pastes it with an instruction to pick up exactly where you left off. • Very long chats are shortened to the first message plus the most recent ones. FOLDERS FOR YOUR CHATS • Save any conversation into color-coded folders. • Reopen it later from any of the three sites. SAVED PROMPTS WITH // SHORTCUTS • Save the prompts you use every day. • Type //name in the chat box to insert one instantly. • Add {variables} to fill in on the fly, like {topic} or {email}. PRIVATE BY DESIGN • Your chats and prompts stay in your browser. No account, no tracking. • Export your whole library to a file and import it on another computer. FREE AND PRO • Free: 5 saved prompts, 5 saved chats and 5 handoffs a month. • Pro: unlimited prompts, chats and handoffs, on up to 3 computers. Monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime license. Works on chatgpt.com, claude.ai and gemini.google.com in Chrome, Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers. It does not work in the desktop apps. Chatrove is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. Questions: support@chatrove.app
